skills.name: List Hyperliquid vaults
skills.description: Discover Hyperliquid vaults: filter by open/closed and relationship (normal / parent / child), sort by TVL, APR or creation time, and cap the count. Each row has vault address, name, leader, TVL, APR, closed flag, relationship and creation time. Send a data part {"skill": "list_vaults", ...input fields}. Input: include_closed (boolean): Include closed vaults. Default false; limit (integer): Max rows to return, 1-999. Default 20; relationship (string): Filter: any (default), normal, parent, or child; sort_by (string): Sort order: tvl (default), apr, or created (newest first). Price: 0.01 U per call (x402).

skills.name: Hyperliquid vault overview
skills.description: Review one Hyperliquid vault by address: leader, strategy description, APR, TVL, follower count, distributable and withdrawable capacity, leader commission and fraction, closed flag and deposit availability. Send a data part {"skill": "vault_overview", ...input fields}. Input: vault_address (string, required): 0x-prefixed Hyperliquid vault address (40 hex chars). Price: 0.01 U per call (x402).
